Predictive Maintenance AI for Process Industries | Novity
Validated in production with U.S. energy supermajors.

TruPrognostics AI delivers a fault diagnosis, multiple likely root cause hypotheses, a recommended next step, and a remaining useful life forecast where the fault mode and data support it. Every output is documented per fault mode and data tier so engineers know what to expect before they trust it.
Most tools detect. Novity truly predicts.
TruPrognostics gives you a probabilistic time-to-failure window for every critical machine. Your team schedules around it instead of scrambling.
The reasoning space is constrained to your OEM manuals, customer SOPs, and prior work history. The system cannot hallucinate.
Validated in production.

Detects over 90% of faults across validated fault modes — with a low false alarm rate. Performance validated in production against customer-confirmed concurrent events. Multiple operators, multiple sites.
40+ days of lead time on a critical compressor at a U.S. energy supermajor.

TruPrognostics AI flagged a developing fault on an Ariel reciprocating compressor 40+ days before the customer's existing monitoring would have caught it. The fault was confirmed at the next inspection. The maintenance team scheduled the work. No emergency callout, no production loss.
Start at Base with data already in your historian. Add sensors per machine to unlock Plus or Premium. No new software, no redeployment.
PI / time-series data from your historian. Process-domain diagnostics and prognostics. Detects efficiency loss, compression changes, and some bearing conditions.
Base data plus one high-frequency vibration sensor. Precise mechanical and bearing diagnostics. Valve leakage and oil whip detection.
Multiple high-frequency sensors and modalities. Maximum diagnostic precision: individual valve identification, crosshead wear, rider band wear.
Built for the rotating and process equipment that runs your plant.
Performance and fouling, from process data alone.
TruPrognostics AI also covers turbines, gearboxes, generators, and more rotating and process equipment. Talk to us about your assets.
The fastest way to evaluate TruPrognostics AI is on your own historian data. We can scope a proof of value in a 30-minute conversation.

Novity Enters Into a Strategic Partnership with Chiyoda Corporation to Deploy an Integrated Solution in Japan, the Middle East and North America by Combining Novity’s TruPrognostics

(Chiyoda) to jointly deploy an integrated solution combining Novity’s truly predictive maintenance AI platform ‘TruPrognostics™ AI’ with Chiyoda’s Operations & Maintenance (O&M) total solution platform ‘plantOS™

Novity and Chiyoda will jointly promote the integrated solution in Japan, the Middle East, and North America, aiming to deliver data‑driven maintenance optimization, operational stability and enhanced equipment reliability.

This partnership will deliver an advanced O&M solution integrating prognostics, diagnostics, anomaly detection, O&M recommendations and operational optimization. The objectives of the partnership are to:
Contribute to improved equipment operational efficiency, reduced downtime, optimized maintenance costs and greater operational safety for customers.

Chiyoda and Novity plan to jointly establish a complete roadmap, from Proof of Concept (PoC) through to commercial deployment, focusing primarily on LNG facilities, refineries, chemical plants, power plants and infrastructure facilities.
What Sets TruPrognostics Apart
Conventional predictive maintenance tools alert operators to anomalies but cannot answer when failure will occur. The integrated plantOS + TruPrognostics AI solution closes this gap and provides:

Unlike data-driven tools that require extensive run-to-failure training data, TruPrognostics AI combines physics-based models with machine learning to achieve 90%+ accuracy even with limited historical data.
TruPrognostics AI is embedded directly into plantOS™, connecting Remaining Useful Life (RUL) predictions to maintenance planning and operations in a single integrated workflow.

Chiyoda Corporation (Chiyoda), headquartered in Yokohama, Japan, is a global engineering and construction company established in 1948. Chiyoda provides integrated services across the project lifecycle, including engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC), serving industries such as energy, chemicals, and infrastructure.

On May 21, 2026, Chiyoda Corporation announced that it has entered into a strategic partnership with Novity, a U.S.-based AI predictive diagnostics technology company.

Novity's AI predictive diagnostics platform, "TruPrognostics AI," will be integrated into Chiyoda's O&M total solution, "plantOS," for joint deployment in Japan, the Middle East, and North America. The target facilities include LNG plants, refineries, chemical plants, power plants, and infrastructure facilities.

The two companies plan to jointly develop a roadmap from Proof of Concept (PoC) to commercial deployment. As of the announcement, what has been disclosed is a partnership aimed at market expansion, rather than a track record of implementing the integrated solution in specific facilities.
From anomaly detection to predicting "when a failure will occur"
TruPrognostics AI is characterized by its ability not only to detect equipment anomalies but also to predict the Remaining Useful Life (RUL).

(Headquarters: California, CEO: Markus Larsson) to jointly deploy a solution that integrates the AI predictive diagnostics platform "TruPrognostics™ AI" with its own O&M total solution platform "plantOS®".

Through this partnership, both companies will accelerate the market deployment of next-generation O&M solutions that realize data-driven maintenance optimization, operational stabilization, and improved equipment reliability, with a primary focus on Japan, the Middle East, and North America.
■ Comprehensive solutions addressing labor shortages and the need for equipment sophistication

In recent years, the industrial plant sector has faced a serious aging of skilled technicians and labor shortages, while the need for predictive maintenance and operational optimization of equipment has been rising rapidly.

千代田化工建設は2026年5月21日、米国のAI予兆診断技術企業Novityと戦略的パートナーシップを締結したと発表した。
NovityのAI予兆診断プラットフォーム「TruPrognostics AI」を、千代田化工建設のO&Mトータルソリューション「plantOS」に統合し、日本・中東・北米で共同展開する。対象はLNG設備、製油所、化学プラント、発電所、インフラ施設。
両社はPoCから商用展開までのロードマップを共同で整備する方針で、発表時点で公表されたのは統合ソリューションとしての特定設備への導入実績ではなく、市場展開に向けた提携である。
TruPrognostics AIは、設備の異常を検知するだけでなく、残存耐用年数（RUL）を予測する仕組みを特徴とする。
物理ベースモデルと機械学習を組み合わせることで、故障に至るまでの大量の履歴データがない環境にも対応する。

千代田化工建設、Novityと戦略的パートナーシップ締結
・AI予兆診断「TruPrognostics™ AI」×plantOS®統合ソリューションを日本・中東・北米で共同展開
（本社：カリフォルニア州、CEO：Markus Larsson）と、AI予兆診断プラットフォーム「TruPrognostics™ AI」と自社のO&Mトータルソリューションプラットフォーム「plantOS®」を統合したソリューションの共同展開に関する戦略的パートナーシップ契約を締結したと発表した。
本提携により、両社は日本・中東・北米を主要対象地域とし、データ駆動型による保全最適化、運転安定化、設備信頼性向上を実現する次世代O&Mソリューションの市場展開を加速させる。
■人材不足と設備高度化ニーズに対応した包括的ソリューション
近年、産業プラント分野では熟練技術者の高齢化・労働力不足が深刻化する一方で、設備の予知保全や運用最適化に対するニーズが急速に高まっている。
この課題に対して、Novity社の物理モデルとAIを融合した高精度予兆診断技術「TruPrognostics™ AI」と、千代田化工建設のplantOS®を連携させることで、残存耐用年数（RUL）の高精度予測、精緻な機器診断、実行可能な保全計画立案・運転最適化提言までをカバーする包括的なソリューションを提供する。
